exemplars.title: Dynamite: Real-Time Debriefing Slide Authoring through AI-Enhanced Multimodal Interaction
exemplars.why: This is the clearest structural match: drawn circles or brush marks identify visual referents while simultaneous speech supplies the requested operation, and both channels are fused into one command. The concrete examples make the interaction directly reconstructable and transferable to other visual workspaces.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: Dynamite outranks One Kiss because its evidence demonstrates simultaneous channel fusion at the level of an individual command, rather than only describing complementary inputs to a generation request.

exemplars.title: One Kiss: Emojis as Agents of Genre Flux in Generative Comics
exemplars.why: One generation request receives two physically distinct input streams with an unusually crisp division of labor: sketched panel frames determine structural pacing, while typed keywords and emojis determine atmosphere. It is a strong example of multimodal input enabling orthogonal control dimensions that either channel alone could not express as effectively.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: One Kiss outranks GazePointAR because the evidence specifies exactly what information each channel contributes, making the fusion mechanism more reconstructable despite its narrower domain.

exemplars.title: GazePointAR: A Context-Aware Multimodal Voice Assistant for Pronoun Disambiguation in Wearable Augmented Reality
exemplars.why: GazePointAR fuses speech with gaze, pointing gestures, and conversational context to resolve the referent of a single spoken query. Its channels are load-bearing rather than decorative: embodied signals supply information that the speech request leaves ambiguous, demonstrating multimodal input as an arbitration mechanism.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: GazePointAR outranks SketchGPT because its evidence identifies the concrete fusion problem and the role of the added channels, whereas SketchGPT's abstract claims integration without showing an individual fused command or its interpretation.

notes: I retained consensus ranks 1 and 3 but promoted rank 4 GazePointAR over rank 2 SketchGPT. SketchGPT substantially overlaps Dynamite's sketch-plus-speech design, and its abstract-level evidence establishes integration less concretely; GazePointAR adds a distinct and structurally explicit example of multimodal arbitration. All score adjustments are below 0.3. Readers should treat claims about conflict handling, timing, and observed user benefit cautiously: One Kiss and GazePointAR are supported here only by abstracts, while even Dynamite's supplied excerpt demonstrates successful combinations but not how contradictory channels are resolved.
